document: The 2026 Annual Report of the Board of Trustees of the Federal Old-Age and Survivors Insurance and Federal Disability Insurance Trust Funds
table_of_record: V.A2 - Immigration Assumptions, Calendar Years 1940-2100 [in thousands]
fetch_method: Browser network-response capture after browser-header curl returned HTTP 403. A throwaway headless Google Chrome profile fetched the authoritative SSA URL; the Fetch API arrayBuffer() exposed the content-decoded HTTP 200 response body, which was committed directly and sha256-pinned without a transcription step. This reproduces the acquisition route already documented in scripts/extract_ssa_tr_ultimate_assumptions_2014.py:1-11 for the same 403 class. Akamai adds request-specific delivery markup, so the hash identifies this one reviewed acquisition.
note: Table V.A2 separates the LPR and temporary-or-unlawfully-present stocks, each with inflow, outflow, adjustment of status and net change, plus a total net change column. The reader consumes the four scenario sections (historical, intermediate, low-cost, high-cost) by their in-table anchor rows (alt_h, alt_2, alt_1, alt_3). The page's data rows carry UNCLOSED <td> tags around the calendar-year cell, so the repo's existing _AllTablesParser in scripts/build_ssa_level_anchors.py (which raises on a nested cell) cannot read this page; the reader implements implicit cell close instead.
